$comment: Rules, enforced by the gate itself:
* high and critical advisories are NEVER allowed here - the gate fails on them;
* every entry names one advisory id, the package, why it cannot be fixed today,
and what makes it unreachable in this product;
* every entry expires; the gate fails once the expiry date has passed;
* an entry that no longer matches a real advisory fails the gate, so the list
cannot rot into a blanket suppression.

allowed.title: minimatch has potential denial of service via globparts amplification
allowed.reason: Reachable only through exceljs -> archiver -> readdir-glob / archiver-utils -> glob -> minimatch. Every published glob and archiver release today still resolves minimatch below 11.0.1, and the versions exceljs pins call minimatch as a bare function, so an override to 11.x would break the export writers.
allowed.unreachableBecause: The vulnerable code is archive.glob()'s pattern matching. This product only ever writes workbooks in memory (new ExcelJS Workbook(), worksheet.addRow, workbook.xlsx.writeBuffer) and never creates an archiver or calls glob; no source file imports archiver or calls .glob().
allowed.evidence: backend/src/modules/export/writers.ts, backend/src/modules/import/tabular.ts, backend/src/modules/import/import.service.ts use only the workbook API; grep for 'archiver' and '.glob(' in src/ returns nothing.
allowed.recheck: Remove this entry when exceljs publishes a release whose archiver chain resolves minimatch >= 11.0.1, or when the export writers stop using exceljs.
